title: Spring Security Advisories - 2026-06-09
description:
Merged 26 spring security advisories published on 2026-06-09. Original advisory IDs: CVE-2026-40993, CVE-2026-40988, CVE-2026-41003, CVE-2026-41694, CVE-2026-41008, CVE-2026-41706, CVE-2026-47838, CVE-2026-41726, CVE-2026-41727, CVE-2026-41731, CVE-2026-41732, CVE-2026-41701, CVE-2026-41714, CVE-2026-41695, CVE-2026-41697, CVE-2026-41696, CVE-2026-41711, CVE-2026-41716, CVE-2026-41717, CVE-2026-41730, CVE-2026-41719, CVE-2026-41721, CVE-2026-41728, CVE-2026-41729, CVE-2026-41837, CVE-2026-40991

Titles:
- Unfiltered Java Native Deserialization of SAML 2.0 Asserting Party Credentials BLOB Database Entry
- Unbounded DEFLATE Inflation in SAML 2.0 Service Provider
- Unencoded HTML Outputs in Spring Security May Allow Cross-Site Scripting
- SAML Payloads Decrypted Without Valid Signature
- Spring Security Authorization Server Open Redirect via request_uri
- Open Redirect When Using CookieRequestCache
- Unauthorized User Impersonation when Using X.509 Client Certificates
- In Spring for Apache Kafka, unbounded delegate cache keyed on user-controlled, potentially malicious selector header
- In Spring for Apache Kafka, forged retry topic headers subvert retry routing and backoff behavior
- In Spring for Apache Kafka, overly broad trusted-package matching in header mappers exposes JDK classes to deserialization
- In Spring for Apache Pulsar, overly broad trusted-package matching in header mapper exposes JDK classes to deserialization
- In Spring AMQP sequential correlation IDs enable reply poisoning on fixed reply queues
- In Spring AMQP the `RabbitConnectionFactoryBean.setUri("amqps://...")` bypasses secure SSL setup, uses `TrustEverythingTrustManager`
- Denial of Service in Spring Data Commons Property Path Resolution
- Spring Data Relational Parameter not Escaped for Query By Example LIKE Pattern
- Spring Data MongoDB Bind Parameter Literal Quoting Breakout
- Potential Denial of Service through crafted Sort Parameters
- Spring Data web support unbounded negative-result cache keyed on attacker-supplied property names
- Spring Data MongoDB - SpEL Expression Injection via Annotated Query Parameter Binding
- Spring Data REST exposes persistence-layer internals in error responses
- Spring Data KeyValue - SpEL Injection vulnerability in SpelPropertyComparator
- Spring Data Commons Denial of Service via Data Binding
- Spring Data REST JSON Patch bypasses Jackson read-only property protection on nested objects and collections
- Spring Data REST SpEL Injection via Map Key in JSON Patch
- Spring Data REST Querydsl integration exposes Jackson-hidden persistent fields as filter keys
- XML External Entity (XXE) injection when documenting untrusted XML content
